key_reasoning.reason: New markdown parser (fence-aware, CRLF-safe, legacy-alias table) compared against the createProgram() registry. The closest precedent is the fence rule in tips-validator. The enumerated edge cases (fenced # comments, body-only mentions, CRLF, nested headings) each have their own parser test, so the check is more than a copy-and-adapt.
One new test file (commands-doc-coverage.test.ts) and one documentation file (COMMANDS.md). No production code changed.
